baseline: GIAB HG002 GRCh38 v5.0q stvar; full chr20 VCF context retained
primary_regions: All official v5.0q chr20 structural benchmark BED intervals; no restriction to DELLY query windows
truth_contained_small_variants: retain for refinement; do not prefilter by benchmark BED or 50 bp size
spanning_deletion_star_policy: exclude records with ALT=* from the bench input as directed by GIAB README; preserve original truth VCF
native_call_policy: retain all original records; pass and nonreference selection only in comparator
duplication_assumption: Truvari treats native DUP as a perfect reference-sequence tandem insertion; this is a representation assumption, not sequence validation
refinement_plan: Use full sequence context, two threads, and MAFFT if available. Preserve original bench counts and label any representation-count changes. Unresolved symbolic calls must be examined before treating refinement as an accuracy estimate.
required_checks_before_interpretation: Native comparator positive, negative and decomposed-allele controls
Reference equality and complete benchmark REF validation on chr20
Counts by deletion and insertion-like class and size
Curated examples of apparent false positives and false negatives
No upgrade of this chromosome pilot to whole-genome, mosaic, clinical or raw-read alignment validation
